findings.drift_class: stale-comment | superseded-model | rendered-lag | adr-index | env-mismatch | retired-rule | duplicated-claim | missing-doc
findings.title: 5-10 word statement of the drift
findings.doc_says: verbatim quote of the drifted doc line
findings.code_says: the contradicting code location (path:line or symbol) or 'removed by <sha>'
findings.body: one-paragraph explanation tying the doc claim to the code fact
findings.suggested_change: corrected text for lines start_line..line, or omit

notes: Findings with path+line are posted inline; omit both for cross-file/architectural drift.
suggested_change posts as a committable suggestion: emit it only when the corrected line text is exact.
